statement: For a finite-bit rational dense symmetric CPTP broadcaster B:M_d->M_d tensor M_d with equal unital trace-preserving HS-self-adjoint marginals Phi, there is a randomized polynomial-bit algorithm which, given delta in (0,1] and failure target eta, returns with probability at least 1-eta an explicitly listed finite canonical EB channel Psi satisfying I-Psi <= 2 ceil(log_2(d^2-1))(I-Phi)+delta I on the traceless Hermitian space.
assumptions: The dense broadcaster descriptor is exact rational data (or an algebraic representation with polynomially bounded degree and exact arithmetic cost).
The input promises or exactly certifies that B is CPTP and symmetric and that both marginals equal the supplied Phi.
The requested compiler is allowed randomized output with stated failure probability eta and additive slack delta.
The dense descriptor and the exact marginal map are available to the compiler; this does not cover a device-only black box.
status: internally derived constructive theorem; proof and complexity audit recorded; independent internal components completed; not externally reviewed and not a priority claim
novelty_boundary: The broadcast-tree support comparison is the existing internally reconstructed logarithmic comparator. Matrix Bernstein/Chernoff and matrix multiplicative weights are standard. The construction connecting the sampled tree response to an exact rational N+1-outcome canonical EB strategy and then to one explicit finite mixture is internally derived here; no external priority claim is made. It does not prove a dimension-free factor, the sharp factor 2 in general, or the bounded-Holevo lift without extra effective-complexity control.
costs: A full tree has K=2^m=O(d^2) leaves and O(d^2) internal nodes.
One exact sampled tree outcome costs O(K d^6) dense arithmetic contractions for a Liouville broadcaster, plus polynomial-bit exact categorical sampling.
The conservative total arithmetic count is O(T N K d^6); rational bit lengths remain polynomial in the explicit input bit length, K, and requested precision.
The output is an explicit POVM/state list with T(N+1) outcomes and O(T N d^2) matrix entries; generic Naimark measurement and mixed-state preparation are polynomial in this representation size.
The broadcaster is used offline through its dense description; the deployed measure-and-prepare channel requires no broadcaster calls.
failure_probability: Union bound over matrix Bernstein covariance events, matrix Chernoff POVM-completion events, and capped exact-rational sampling rejection; fresh samples each adaptive round.
falsifier: A counterexample to the exact tree support inequality or to the claimed sampler law; a failure of the rational residual effect completion to yield a canonical HS-self-adjoint unital TP EB map; a violation of the MMW regret sign/bound; or a bit-growth/eigensolver lower bound superpolynomial in d, 1/delta, and finite input bit length.
next_gate: Independent hostile audit of the complete support-to-finite-channel proof, especially the direction-dependent PVM implementation, exact canonical residual completion on the traceless HS space, adaptive concentration union bound, and bit-precision of matrix exponential queries. Separately, pursue the unresolved dimension-free c=2 comparison; this compiler does not settle it.
